about: Beams crossing as in haze: two orange beams cross and their light adds up, still orange where it is brighter than it can show, not washed to white; a purple beam up the middle mixes with each; a cyan one leaning away from the viewer shows its far end as a soft disc; a dimmed head's flare is smaller and less white than a bright one's; a string's dots stay whole over the beams, adding nothing.
